affectedCopies: Decision log per-tier read model (WWMD/WWWD/WSID stat cards and timeline)

migration.name: 20260720200000_decision_interaction_gate_key
migration.backfill: additive only: two nullable/defaulted columns plus one index. Existing rows are backfilled from the joined DecisionPerspectiveProfile.kind (platform->build-studio, organization->org-business, profession->profession). The backfill is exact rather than approximate because the profession gate had never executed when these rows were written (live census at time of change: 169 platform, 10 organization, 0 profession), so no historical row's gate is ambiguous. No rows are deleted, no column is dropped, no value is overwritten.

changes.lifecycleDisposition: every existing DecisionInteraction row is retained unchanged apart from gaining a derived gateKey; the ledger remains append-only and no interaction is reclassified away from a tier it was correctly filed under

fields.reason: the governance audit tier must derive from the gate that produced the row, not from the fallback-resolved profile: evaluateProfessionDecisionGate resolves to MARK_DPF_PLATFORM_PROFILE whenever the craft corpus has no material, so a WSID decision persisted with profileId=mark-dpf-platform and audited as WWMD, leaving the WSID tier reading 'never used' however often the gate ran
fields.provenance: BI-1BE30A9A file:line evidence; amended contract in docs/superpowers/plans/2026-07-06-decision-governance-audit-log.md (supersedes its original profile-kind attribution rule); functional reproduction on the live install produced DI-5EBFC997637F with gateKey=profession, gateFallbackUsed=true, profileId=mark-dpf-platform

fields.reason: preserves the 'was this the coworker's own doctrine or a cross-kind fallback?' signal that profile kind previously carried implicitly, so a WSID row decided from platform defaults is not mistaken for one grounded in the profession's craft corpus
fields.provenance: BI-1BE30A9A; profession-gate.test.ts asserts the flag on both the fallback and own-corpus paths
